PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Edgar's clue ("He was sitting in a chair. He was in a corner of his area."). So Edgar (E) must be at row 3, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Cecily's clue ("She was in the same area as someone else on a carpet.") needs the person on a carpet in Cecily's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Cecily. All of Daisy's squares are in row 1, so nobody else can use it. All of Arlo's squares are in row 4, so nobody else can use it. Cecily's own clue ("She was in the same area as someone else on a carpet.") rules out more squares. So Cecily (C) must be at row 5, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: The murderer must be in Vince's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Vince. Arlo is now the only person who can still go in column 2. So Arlo (A) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Who can be the person on a carpet in Cecily's area? Only Bella, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Cecily's clue ("She was in the same area as someone else on a carpet."). That rules out Bella's other squares. So Bella (B) must be at row 6, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Daisy that fits her clue ("She was in the Kitchen, but not beside a shelf."). So Daisy (D) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vince. So Vince (the victim) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Edgar is the only person in the Counter with Vince, so Edgar is the murderer!
